verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships a browser-based visual Editor with drag-and-drop scene building, a viewport, live tweaking of materials and positions, and real-time multi-user scene editing. Independent community comments confirm it 'comes with a nice scene editor'. Concerns about offline use and cloud-hosted projects do not contradict the visual-editor capability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of prefab/template workflows, documentation of an inspector/property panel, and hands-on reports of level building as the primary workflow.
